title: Stratégies des filières fromagères sous AOP en Europe
bookshelves: Category: Economics, Finance, Business and Management
summary: To explain the origin of the differences in milk prices paid to producers, this work provides a framework for analyzing the mechanisms of governance of PDO cheeses, which are organised in localised agri-food systems (SYAL).
